rationale.problem_value: 优先级 1：直接提出几何修复可用空间与动作保护之间的可识别边界；便于与强普通修复作同目标对照。
rationale.mathematical_consequence: Differentiating the strictly convex W-quadratic yields the KKT system. The Gram pseudoinverse is legitimate because Cd lies in its range, including redundant C rows. An independently parameterized nullspace least-squares witness agrees. Full column rank C eliminates all repair freedom, so protecting every velocity is not proposed. Choose scalar s=sqrt(1-rho). Then ||sd||_W=||p||_W and q(0)-q(sd)>=q(0)-q(p), but C(sd)=s Cd. If C=Dpsi(y) and ||D^2 psi||<=L locally, Cp=0 implies ||psi(y+p)-psi(y)||<=L||p||_2^2/2.

Changes the admissible update subspace rather than adjusting a global regularization strength; classical projection is attributed. Originality remains unadjudicated; merge/reclassify if function-level review finds full coverage.
rationale.distinguishing_prediction: Protected linear motion moments stay unchanged while unprotected geometry directions move; benefit should vanish when ker C is trivial. The projected local quadratic gain fraction is 1-rho; equal-W-norm scalar shrinkage has at least its geometry gain but generally changes C y. Decisive comparison: Native ActionMesh, same geometry repair without C, projected repair, and scalar-blend replacement at matched repair cost/tuning; freeze C before confirmation. Also match W-step norm using s=sqrt(1-rho), log Cd/Cdelta/rho and distinguish those diagnostics from full native scores.

No full native cost or live GPU allocation is currently established. 本轮排序依据：保护的局部代价与缩步强对照已明确；native motion relevance 仍待检验。

rationale.problem_value: 优先级 2：低额外解码成本、严格自映射边界，是参考误差诊断及C03必要强对照；SFG已有差分锚定，本条目前不能按原创贡献计。

Direct-coordinate semantics are matched to the pinned decoder.

Originality remains unadjudicated; merge/reclassify if function-level review finds full coverage.

Decisive comparison: Same latent/context/seed, full native ActionBench scoring; F_t versus H_t versus mean-bias fit; all arms pay the self-query cost or receive equal total budget.
rationale.feasibility_and_cost: One additional decoder target-time query per cached context; no training. Cache/replay and full-mesh timing must be qualified. No full native cost or live GPU allocation is currently established. 本轮排序依据：原生坐标与同上下文 self-map 接口明确，优先作为固定校正对照，不冒称原创。

rationale.problem_value: 优先级 3：将局部差分修复投影为可积全局场；可作为所有对应分支的共同重建基础和独立约束比较。

rationale.problem_value: 优先级 6：在C02基础上检验不确定方向的最坏情形约束是否必要；须先证明不确定集有实际意义。

A finite smooth step adds L||delta||^2/2; merely satisfying a linearized surrogate budget cannot promise native CD-M noninferiority or probabilistic coverage.

rationale.feasibility_and_cost: Small structured conic solve after cached output repair. Reliable uncertainty and smoothness bounds are unresolved. No full native cost or live GPU allocation is currently established. 本轮排序依据：稳健保护仍需合法梯度与覆盖，不过对照可直接与 C02 的固定局部 repair 比较。

rationale.problem_value: 优先级 7：相关参考误差仍值得检验，但平方/非平方目标不等价、合法材料对应和跨资产标定未闭合，低于无标定或更直接识别分支。数学边界修订使原第2位降到第7位，不代表实测失败。
rationale.mathematical_consequence: The true-moment squared identity survives; an exact centered counterexample refutes transfer to unsquared risk. Smoothed affine MM produces a conditional development-only descent theorem, not native efficacy.

rationale.problem_value: 优先级 8：区分时间相位错配和幅度不足，减少把所有运动误差当坐标噪声的混淆；合法目标尚需资格验证。

Qualify legal targets, gauges, rank, kappa and interpolation remainder before interpreting a decomposition; no evaluator timestamp changes.

selection_scope: Conditional research shortlist for code/experiment design; not scientific admission or a list of 15 original/working methods.
ranking_policy: Qualitative comparison of task value, derivation consequence, comparator delta, falsifiable prediction and resource feasibility. No invented novelty or effect scores.

structural_relations.relationship: C01 fixed unit correction is nested in C03 regression; C03 introduces development-fitted means/cross-moments and estimation risk. Treat as related constructions, not two independent mechanisms or two novel contributions.

Prescribed-step equality projection, uncertain conic budget, and protected-residual nuclear-norm estimation have different admissible sets/estimators. They share the protection question and are not independent evidence.

Joint spatial discrete mode decision, balanced area transport, slack-enabled partial transport/fallback, and path-law endpoint KL projection act on different objects. C06/C07 are nested mass models and must share controls.
Rotation graph gauge, field integrability, stretch spectrum and line-area feasibility constrain different objects. A common lift must not be counted as an extra independent method.
Temporal group-norm prior, frozen body coordinates, protected low-rank residual and internal phase/amplitude inference differ structurally; timing and geometry metrics remain the same.
Anchor experiment design, spatial query allocation, camera nuisance elimination and latent output-metric coefficients have distinct decision variables; all remain reserve paths.

admission_rule: Do not implement a new candidate until Natural Gate 0, strongest simple baseline and required importance/collision gates admit it. If fully covered, merge or classify as a baseline rather than pad the pool.
